question: A travelled from a place P to place Q at an average speed of 36 km/h. He travelled the first 75% of the distance in four-fifth of the time and the rest at a constant speed of x km/h. The value of x is :
solution:
**Formula:**

Average speed = Total distance driven ÷ Total time taken

**Calculation:**

Let the time taken be "t"

Total distance driven = 36 × t = 36t

According to the question-

⇒ 3over4 × 36t = 27t driven in <span class=&q
